subject: Release or commit: Q2 stale opportunities triage
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Roberto Silva <roberto@lighthousehealth.com>, contracts@lighthousehealth.com
Date: Sat, 03 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Release or commit: Q2 stale opportunities triage

Team — quick triage request for a small set of Q2 opportunities that are holding the forecast hostage. Attached is a snapshot (Q2_commit_snapshot.csv) pulled this morning and the current SOW draft (Lighthouse_SOW_v2.pdf). Please do the following by EOD PT today:

1) For any opp you can confidently commit (firm PO / signed SOW imminent) reply with "COMMIT" and the expected revenue amount.
2) For opps where there is no movement / no buyer signal in the last 30 days, reply with "RELEASE" so we can archive for forecasting and reduce upside risk.
3) If you need me or Sales Ops to trigger a legal/contract push (DocuSign, expedited billing), reply with "ESCALATE" and I will loop Legal.

List highlights in the CSV: 6 opps > 45 days without activity; 2 opps with expired proposals sitting in "Contracting" stage. My ask is to clean these up so Finance can produce a defensible commit number for the Monday forecast.

Thanks — short replies are fine.

—Marissa Cole
Sr. Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
(415) 555-0198

Attachments: Q2_commit_snapshot.csv (csv), Lighthouse_SOW_v2.pdf (pdf)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Roberto Silva <roberto@lighthousehealth.com>
Date: Sat, 03 Apr 2027 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Release or commit: Q2 stale opportunities triage

On Apr 3, 2027, at 9:12 AM, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team — quick triage request for a small set of Q2 opportunities that are holding the forecast hostage.

COMMIT: DEAL-1942 (Lighthouse Health) — Roberto confirmed verbal approval yesterday; Legal has final redline on page 3 that I reviewed with their GC and they said "no blockers". Expect signed SOW and PO by 04/08. Estimated ARR: $148,000. I will follow up with Roberto this morning and push for signature.

Note: I will ESCALATE if I don't see DocuSign by Wednesday morning.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive
ben_carter@redwood.com

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 03 Apr 2027 10:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Release or commit: Q2 stale opportunities triage

Thanks Marissa — I reviewed the CSV and have two quick calls out of the list:

- OP-2891 (MedTech pilot) — no activity since 2/15. SDR attempted outreach last week; no reply. Recommend RELEASE unless AE can produce a committed next-step calendar invite by COB.
- OP-3022 (Regional health system) — customer requested custom SLA text; legal back-and-forth started 3/12, but last contact 3/28 where they asked for updated SLA. I put ESCALATE because Legal will need to push the SLA wording; if Legal confirms they can accept our standard with minor edits, Ben can convert to COMMIT.

For the remaining opps, a few are warm but low confidence — propose marking as "Best Case" in forecast and removing from Commit column. If anyone objects, raise now so we don't overstate.

Monica Patel
Manager, Sales Operations
monica_patel@redwood.com

Ben / Marissa — quick note from my side: I can confirm Lighthouse Health is ready to proceed on DEAL-1942. We had one last internal budget sign-off yesterday; SOW looks fine pending the contract appendix update Ben mentioned. I will sign the SOW by Wednesday 04/07 and route PO to your finance contacts that day.

If Legal needs anything from our procurement team to speed the appendix, loop them (contracts@lighthousehealth.com) and we will prioritize.

Thanks — Roberto
